# HiMeet (Rook Club)

> HiMeet is a social network with free worldwide classifieds (with built-in translation of ads and chat), 18+ dating, and online chess where players can stake USDC on the Polygon network. It also has free chess puzzles, free tournaments and chess NFTs. A smart contract holds chess stakes and the winner receives 90% of the pot. For adults only (18+). Stakes carry the risk of losing and some features may be unavailable in some countries.

## What you can do on the site

- Social network (Rook Club): public profiles, posts with photos, a feed, comments, followers, private messages and voice messages.
- Classifieds for the whole world: ads for sale, wanted, rent, jobs and services by country and city. Ads and chat messages are translated into the reader's language, and a built-in chat connects buyer and seller. The first ad is free; extra ads cost 1 USDC for 30 days; optional paid options (renewal, top placement) are paid in USDC.
- Dating (18+): free profiles with 3 photos, filters, likes, matches and private chat.
- Chess for stakes: two players each stake USDC (0.5 to 500 USDC per game) and the ChessEscrow smart contract on Polygon holds the money. The winner receives 90% of the pot.
- Free chess: play against a bot or a friend by private link, no stake needed.
- Chess puzzles, free hourly tournaments with points, badges and cups, daily quests, and chess NFTs (a move from your own finished game as an ERC-721 NFT on Polygon).

## Key facts

- Currency and network: USDC on Polygon. A small amount of POL pays network fees. Signing in is free: one wallet signature, no gas.
- Chess fee: 10% of the pot, so the winner receives 90%. Draws, cancelled games and games whose result cannot be recorded are refunded in full.
- Stakes are held by a smart contract (ChessEscrow, 0xaf8714656261dc770A41857706FF4b2f495e92e9), verified on Polygonscan. The winner claims the prize with a Claim button. The chess NFT contract (GameNFT, 0xD929546324c0d675C16C8005F2df59D79AEFf87B) is also verified on Polygonscan.
- The contracts have not had a paid third-party audit. Game results are reported by a server-side oracle key.
- Free modes: games against a bot and private games with a friend need no stake. Classifieds, the feed, dating and puzzles are free to use (only extra ads and optional classifieds options cost USDC).
- Also available as a Telegram Mini App: https://t.me/chess_betlolbot/game and as an Android app.
- Private messages are stored on the server and are not end-to-end encrypted. HiMeet never asks for a secret recovery phrase or private key.
- Contact: chessgrokearn@gmail.com

## Languages

The site is available in English first, with Russian and several other languages in the interface.
